title: GuardrailConfigPublished.v1
description: A guardrail configuration version was published and is now immutable (plan §6.5 catalogue extension, §7 DEC-4). Emitted by strategy-service on `collections.strategy` keyed by `configId`. treatment-service consumes it to refresh the contact windows and frequency caps it enforces immediately before every dispatch (DEC-16); a stale cache is a real risk here, which is why the refresh has a poll fallback and the guardrail check fails closed rather than assuming the previous configuration still holds.

configId.description: Identifier of the guardrail configuration family, e.g. `GLOBAL_GUARDRAILS`. Also the partition key.

version.description: Published version. Recorded on every treatment that was checked against it.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 (lowercase hex) of the canonical JSON of the published `guardrail-config.v1.json` document — the evidence for "which windows and caps were in force when this message went out at 20:58?".
